predecessors.name: Second Syrian Republic
predecessors.text: the Second Syrian Republic, whose 1950 constitution was back in force after the coup

successors.name: Syrian Arab Republic under the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party
successors.text: Syria without the Golan Heights, the Syrian state under the neo-Ba'athist regime of 23 February 1966

ledger.x: 28 September 1961: a coup in Damascus restores Syrian independence and ends the union with Egypt.
1961: the restored republic takes the name Syrian Arab Republic.
8 March 1963: the Ba'ath Military Committee seizes power in Damascus.
23 February 1966: the neo-Ba'athist Military Committee overthrows the party's old guard.
ledger.cpn: Syrian Arab Republic under the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party
